messages:
mira: quick sync  we have two pilot customers asking for SLA exceptions (99.9% for Dedicated) and a temporary burst allowance. Need a compact "one-pager" exception playbook for sales by EOD. who can own?

anya: I can collect pilot asks and build the sales template. need to know what tech mitigations product/ops require.

sam: technical constraints: 99.9% is ok only with reserved capacity + explicit fallback behavior. without reserved capacity we expose other tenants.

kyle: pricing: propose a 30-day pilot burst allowance with an overage cap. finance must approve provisional rates; i'll draft the invoice-example.

leo: ops: to keep this safe we need 1) regional canary + isolation, 2) automatic fallback to smaller model variant on sustained p95 degradation, and 3) tenant-level burst quotas (soft warning + hard cap).

mira: outline for the one-pager: decision owner, approval window, required mitigations, billing stub, rollback trigger, and post-pilot review. concise.

eva: i'll author the doc stub and include a sample invoice snippet and a short billing example table. will mark numbers TBD.

dan-legal: legal: can provide an addendum template but need exact SLA numbers and length. include clause: "pilot exceptions temporary, revocable after capacity review."

sam: fallback runbook sketch:
```
Trigger: p95 > 500ms sustained for 5m in primary region
Actions:
  - attempt scale (2m)
  - if scale fails, switch affected tenants to variant "v2-small"
  - page oncall + sales_ops channel
Revert: p95 < 350ms for 10m
```

leo: also implement token quota guard: soft warning at 80% of pilot burst allowance, hard cap enforced at opt-in limit.

anya: proposed commercial flow:
- Sales submits exception request (template)
- Finance provides provisional pricing
- Legal issues addendum
- Product approves mitigations
- Ops schedules canary and enables exception
- Post-pilot review within 14 days

mira: owners: anya (sales template + intake), kyle (pricing example), dan-legal (addendum), sam+leo (fallback, canary, quota guards), eva (docs one-pager). deploy-bot: canary slot?

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline slot requested: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (pending ops approval).

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation starts 2026-03-27. ensure runbook pages the right duty.

kyle: i'll draft the provisional pricing table and invoice example for the doc. finance will join 3pm sync.

dan-legal: ETA: addendum draft by tomorrow AM once SLA line confirmed.

sam: ETA: fallback RFC + runbook by EOD tomorrow.

leo: ETA: quota guard + alert wiring in 48h. will prep regional isolation steps for the canary.

eva: ETA: docs PR (one-pager + invoice example) by EOD today.

mira: OK we reconvene 3pm to review the one-pager before handing to sales. keep it <1 page. :white_check_mark: 

anya: ack, i'll bring the sales intake template.

kyle: ack. finance on standby.

sam: ack.

leo: ack."
